studio.name: Aariv's web studio
studio.method: I direct AI coding agents (OpenCode, Claude Code, Antigravity) that do the typing; I plan, spec, review and test every change before it ships.

sites.name: A foster-based cat rescue
sites.what: Foster-based cat rescue: mission, adoptable cats, donate pathways. Built to load fast and read warmly on a phone, since most donors arrive from social links.

sites.name: A community food pantry
sites.what: Free-food pantry: hours, location, what to expect on a first visit. Plain language and large type, because visitors are often in a hurry or stressed.

sites.name: A no-kill cat rescue
sites.what: No-kill cat rescue: adoptable cats, foster program and donate flow. Designed around big friendly photography and a sticky donate path, since rescue sites live or die on donations.

sites.name: A community-cat (TNR) rescue
sites.what: Community-cat rescue (trap, neuter, return): explains TNR in plain language with a step-by-step for first-time colony caretakers. Information-first design; the audience needs answers, not animations.
